What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

videos.caption: Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Heat oil in a separate pan over medium-low heat. Fry the plantain chunks until tender but not too browned. Remove and flatten each piece with a tostonera or the bottom of a cup. 4. INGREDIENTS CHICKEN + 1 lb chicken breasts + 1 tsp smoked paprika + 1 tbsp garlic powder + 1 tsp Italian seasoning + 1 tsp black pepper + ½ tsp salt + 1 tbsp avocado oil PASTA + 10 oz rigatoni + ½ cup reserved pasta water, plus more as needed CREAMY TUSCAN SAUCE + 2 cups heavy cream + 1½ tbsp butter + 2 tbsp cooking oil + 1 shallot, diced + 10 garlic cloves, minced + ½ red bell pepper, diced + 12 cherry tomatoes, halved + ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped + 1 cup freshly grated Parmesan + 1 cup baby spinach + ¾ tsp chicken bouillon powder SAUCE SEASONINGS + ½ tsp smoked paprika + ½ tsp garlic powder + ½ tsp black pepper + ½ tsp Italian seasoning + ¼ tsp red pepper flakes + Salt to taste FINISHING + 1–2 tsp fresh lemon juice (optional) + Fresh parsley + Extra Parmesan DIRECTIONS + STEP 1: SEASON & SEAR Butterfly chicken into cutlets and coat with seasonings. Crispy Baked Chicken Thighs Get ready for the ultimate easy dinner. These bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs are seasoned to perfection and baked until the skin is beautifully shattered-crisp while the meat stays incredibly juicy and tender. Ingredients Chicken: 6 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs Oil: 1.5 tbsp olive oil (or melted butter) The Seasoning Blend: 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp dried oregano or thyme 1 tsp kosher salt 1/2 tsp cracked black pepper 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, for a tiny kick) Instructions Prep: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a rimmed baking sheet or baking dish with aluminum foil for easy cleanup. Dry the Skin: Pat the chicken thighs completely dry with paper towels. This is the most important step for achieving maximum skin crispiness! Season: In a small bowl, mix all the spices together. Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken thighs, then rub the spice mixture generously all over them, making sure to get underneath the skin as well. Arrange: Place the chicken thighs on the prepared baking sheet, skin-side up, leaving a little space between each piece so they roast instead of steam. Bake: Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the skin is deeply browned and crispy, and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) at the thickest part. Rest: Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving to lock in all those delicious juices. Tip: If you want an extra-shattery, charred crust, pop them under the oven broiler for the last 2–3 minutes of cooking. Just keep a close eye on them so they don't burn! #BakedChicken #ChickenThighs #EasyDinner #CrispyChicken #SheetPanDinner

🍲 Slow Cooker Cheesy Chicken Potato & Corn Casserole 🍲 A comforting, dump-and-go casserole loaded with tender chicken, potatoes, sweet corn, and a rich, cheesy cream sauce. It cooks effortlessly in the slow cooker! INGREDIENTS: - 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts, diced - 2 lbs baby potatoes, halved or quartered - 1 1/2 cups corn kernels (fresh, frozen, or drained canned) - 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup - 1/4 cup milk or chicken broth - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1/2 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper - 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled - 2 tbsp chopped parsley INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Place the diced chicken and baby potatoes into the slow cooker. Season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 2. Whisk the cream of chicken soup with the milk or broth, then pour it over the chicken and potatoes. 3. Sprinkle the corn kernels over the top. 4. Sprinkle the cheddar cheese and crispy bacon bits over everything. 5. Put the lid on and cook on low for 4-5 hours or on high for 2-3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender. 6. Shred the chicken with two forks, stir everything together, sprinkle with parsley, and serve hot straight from the slow cooker.
